propositions: Define immutable operation/outcome value types with exact enum sets for Disposition, FailureScope, ReplaySafety, and DelaySource, serializing to canonical byte-identical UTF-8 JSON through the existing store seam.

Implement a sole three-invocation, 15-second cumulative fake-clock retry budget owner in the reconciler domain that prevents nesting across adapter layers and enforces one canonical logical_id per operation.

Constrain diagnostic entries to eight maximum with exact six-key allowlist (stage, category, status_code, provider_code, retry_after_ms, message), redact messages via centralized seam, and truncate each message to 512 Unicode code points.
Generate zero-indexed retry delays using additive jitter formula [2^(retry_index+1) + U[0,1)) seconds such that index 0 yields [2s,3s) and index 1 yields [4s,5s), with no third sleep permitted.

After ambiguous writes, observe desired primary-store postcondition before replay; observed desired state returns recovered, failed/inconclusive observation returns non-replaying commit_unknown with forbidden ReplaySafety.
Reject over-budget provider delays by returning retry_not_before without executing hidden work or incrementing invocation counters.
